pass_b_english: The deceitful do not approach to learn, and it is untimely to unfold the deeper things (Mt 21:23). A man had two sons, the first representing the Gentiles, whom God, the common Father, called first. For He gave them the teachable and natural law, sowing it in their minds, and gave them preachers of the things seen, but their orderliness of soul was mixed with wood and stones; for they said to the wood, 'You are my Father' (Mt 21:31). Therefore, they did not endure, saying they did not know the Lord (Mt 21:30). These, then, repented later and went to the vineyard.
